notes.title: Action Ball will be released on Steam
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! 

The first part of our game will be released on Steam soon. We invite everyone to visit the game's page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1837160/Action_Ball/

And don't forget to add us to your wishlists! Stay tuned and we'll try to please you with interesting news, streams and images.

[previewyoutube=xG4t9xKB3Xc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Winter Sale 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218247/f55b36ffc1b921686f9adfc1571d3da95a619dee.png[/img]

Meet the 2020 Steam Winter Sale! 

Welcome to Steamville, where the holidays are in full swing! From now ‘til January 5nd [b]maximum discount[/b] on Action Ball 2 in this year! 

Happy Holidays and Happy Gaming from all your friends in Steamville!

notes.title: Release is here!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YG9O_qAOtqk;full][/previewyoutube]
Take to the skies with the thrilling, brick-busting excitement of Action Ball 2, the electrifying sequel to the hit arcade game! Soar above the clouds in your paddle-equipped ship and fight back the relentless robots in level after level of eye-popping fun.

notes.title: Demo version is available!
notes.content:
[b]Good news, everyone![/b]

The release of Action Ball 2 on Steam is coming soon! Therefore, we have prepared a demo version of the game. 

This is a short playthrough of the demo version:
[previewyoutube=IWcZ5wDPC2c;full][/previewyoutube] 

You can download and play Action Ball 2 demo here (for free, with no ads or text messages):
https://rionix.itch.io/actionball2
Just download, unzip and enjoy!

And don't forget to add us in Steam wishlist. 😉
